page_title: BOC 3-2 HOF | Bochum v Hoffenheim 26/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Here comes a substitution. Felix Passlack is given a rest as he is replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
90+4' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
90+3' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+3' Takuma Asano (Bochum) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
90+2' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+1' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) picks up an injury.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Riemann is alert and denies him.
89' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' Here is a change. Philipp Hofmann is going off and Heiko Butscher gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
88' Matus Bero comes off the pitch to be replaced by Erhan Masovic (Bochum).
86' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
85' Bochum get a corner.
84' 3 - 2 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) receives the ball on the edge of the box and lobs the goalkeeper, who was off his line. He makes it 3:2.
83' Takuma Asano (Bochum) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
81' Matus Bero (Bochum) is able to continue to play.
81' Matus Bero (Bochum) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
80' The referee awards a corner and Kevin Stoger (Bochum) goes over to take it.
80' Felix Passlack (Bochum) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Oliver Baumann stops the ball from going into the top left corner.
79' The corner from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is hurriedly cleared.

79' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
78' Bochum have a corner.

78' Takuma Asano (Bochum) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Bochum will take a corner.
78' A spell of possession for Bochum in an attempt to control the game.
77' Ball possession – 47:53.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Takuma Asano (Bochum) for Maximilian Wittek.
73' 3 - 1 Goal! David Jurasek takes aim and his effort deflects off Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) to beat the goalkeeper. 3:1.
72' The defence successfully catches Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) in the offside trap, but it was close!
70' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
69' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Manuel Riemann punches the ball away.
69' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) replacing Wout Weghorst.
69' It will be a substitution. Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Maximilian Beier walks off.
68' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
67' The linesman raises his flag. Felix Passlack (Bochum) is adjudged offside.
64' 3 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Kevin Stoger (Bochum) and he fired home from close range. The score is 3:0.

64' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

63' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header would probably have ended up low inside the middle of the goal, but Manuel Riemann pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
62' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) tries to find Pavel Kaderabek, but he puts too much power on the pass.
60' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
59' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
59' Bernardo (Bochum) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bochum.
58' A lofted pass finds Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
57' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
56' The substitution has been made. David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) has replaced Robert Skov.

56' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Oliver Baumann.
54' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
53' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul after Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) hacks down one of his opponents. Bochum are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
53' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
52' Bochum take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

52' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Oliver Baumann's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom left corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bochum.
51' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Tobias Stieler stops the game and makes a call. Bochum will take a free kick.

51' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Oliver Baumann was alert and the score remains the same.
50' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim).
47' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) comes off for Finn Ole Becker.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Anton Stach.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Tobias Stieler has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+7' A first-time shot by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. Hoffenheim earn a corner.
45+6' Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
45+5' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies high over the crossbar.
45+4' The shots on goal statistics – 6:0.
45+2' Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Felix Passlack (Bochum), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:0.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Felix Passlack (Bochum) whips the ball into the box and Philipp Hofmann takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
44' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
43' Looks like Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
42' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
39' A pass by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' OFF THE BAR! Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
36' A quickly taken corner by Bochum.
34' 1 - 0 Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the free kick and beats the goalkeeper with a shot which goes inside the left post. Simply stunning!
34' Bochum win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
33' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
33' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Oliver Baumann pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
32' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
31' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
29' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Anthony Losilla (Bochum).
27' The Bochum players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Tobias Stieler. NO PENALTY!
26' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
24' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Hoffenheim.
24' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
23' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
22' Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.
21' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
19' Felix Passlack (Bochum) is penalised for holding. Tobias Stieler signals a set piece.
18' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
17' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
16' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:1.
15' Hoffenheim keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
13' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
12' Neat link-up play between Felix Passlack (Bochum) and Moritz Broschinski, but Oliver Baumann reads the game well and the move breaks down.
12' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

11' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
10' Felix Passlack (Bochum) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
10' Bochum hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Stieler saw the whole situation. A free kick to Hoffenheim.
7' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the left post!
6' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
5' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) will take the corner.
4' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.
4' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
3' Oliver Baumann leaps like a salmon to deny Philipp Hofmann (Bochum), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
2' Dangerous play by Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim). Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The linesman signals that Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler is the one to supervise the game today.
